scripts.predev: node scripts/gen-search-index.mjs public/data/scores.json && node scripts/build-detail-data.mjs public/data/scores.json public/data/inspection_history.json && npm run gen-nyc:dev && npm run gen-la:dev
scripts.gen-nyc:dev: node scripts/gen-search-index.mjs public/data/nyc/scores.json public/data/nyc/search-index.json && node scripts/build-detail-data.mjs public/data/nyc/scores.json public/data/nyc/inspection_history.json "" public/data/nyc
scripts.gen-la:dev: node scripts/gen-search-index.mjs public/data/la/scores.json public/data/la/search-index.json && node scripts/build-detail-data.mjs public/data/la/scores.json public/data/la/inspection_history.json "" public/data/la
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/prebuild-sync-s3.mjs && node scripts/gen-search-index.mjs /tmp/fsi-build-cache/scores.json && node scripts/gen-search-index.mjs /tmp/fsi-build-cache/nyc/scores.json public/data/nyc/search-index.json && node scripts/gen-search-index.mjs /tmp/fsi-build-cache/la/scores.json public/data/la/search-index.json
